'''Meeting Room A3000291''' was a conference room in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. The room was panelled with rare [[laroon wood]].

In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]], and [[Ferus Olin]] met with [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Tyro Caladian]] in this room to learn of the legal complications of pursuing the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Jenna Zan Arbor]] to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid-Rim]] world of [[Romin]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard]]'' {{1st}}
